summary: This bill prohibits federal funds provided to certain State Homeland Security Grant Program recipients from being used for civil immigration enforcement activities, including participation in 287(g) programs, during the 2026 World Cup, except under exigent circumstances involving imminent threats to safety or national security.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly limits the ability of entities receiving federal funds to participate in civil immigration enforcement activities during a specific period related to the World Cup. This restriction on enforcement activities leans towards more immigration, as it temporarily reduces the capacity for deportation or detention.
